results.name: Myllokunmingia fengjiaoa

user.displayName: Oxford University Museum of Natural History

results.description:
Yunnan Province, China, ~518 million years old.

*Myllokunmingia* had a head with a pair of eyes and a nasal opening, up to six pairs of **gills** housed in pouches on the lower surface of the head, and a **dorsal fin** supported by stiff radial rods. It also had **Z-shaped blocks of muscle** and would have been able to swim freely through the water by moving its body side-to-side like a fish.

Created for the First Animals exhibition at Oxford University Museum of Natural History: www.oum.ox.ac.uk/firstanimals

Model by Mighty Fossils: www.mightyfossils.com

results.name: Coin Purse
results.description:
Complex of men's costume for the second half of the XIV century.Coin Purse.
A purse or pouch (from Latin bursa, which in turn comes from the Greek βρρσα, býrsa, oxhide), Sometimes called a coin purse for clarity, is a small money bag or pouch made for carrying coins.
In the XV century, purses were worn by both men and women. They were often finely embroidered or decorated with gold. In addition, men usually gave their new brides purses embroidered with an illustration of a love story.

results.name: Kobold Trap_Setter-Female
results.description:
New Drop: Low-Poly Kobold Trap-Setter Female (PS1 Style)

Expanding the devious dungeon dweller roster on the storefront. Here is a clean, highly stylized low-poly homage to classic PS1-era RPG enemies with this female variant of the Kobold Trap-Setter.

The Specs:

Style: True retro PS1-era low-poly geometry with classic pixelated textures. Captures the cunning reptilian aesthetic perfectly with her green scaly skin, draconic snout, tattered rags, and a heavy utility belt loaded with tools and pouches for her deadly contraptions.

Optimized: Ultra-lightweight with classic segmented joints, making it perfect for mobile, VR, or retro-inspired indie RPG and adventure projects.

Game-Ready: Set in a standard T-pose, scaled to real-world proportions, and ready to drop right into your engine's treacherous dungeons and trap-filled caverns.
